title: Avoid-Crowd Preference During Public Event

agents.persona: Resident who likes evening exercise but strongly dislikes crowded event spaces.
agents.private_intention: Get light exercise and pick up groceries while avoiding the public event crowd.
memory_seeds: The plaza becomes noisy during events.
Riverside Park is a calmer exercise option.

public_context: A free concert begins in Civic Plaza at 18:15 and draws a crowd.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should satisfy exercise and groceries but may route through the crowded plaza if it is shortest.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May mention avoiding crowds but choose the plaza because it is salient in the prompt.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should avoid or leave the plaza after the crowd event starts.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should prioritize Riverside Park based on the calm-place memory.
